items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and approve only existing period-aligned finance reconciliation. Supported revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate tracking row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution; this is not evidence of zero site performance. AI usage reports $973.3548129 across 5,439 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, conflicting with retained records of $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls through 2026-09-26 and $963.5690377 across 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: revenue and cost windows are misaligned; infrastructure, domain, labor, and marketing costs are absent; incremental outcomes are not isolated; and monthly spend, marketing, revenue-target, and revenue-floor limits are blank. Minimum measurement is one reconciled, period-aligned ledger by site and fleet covering revenue, attribution identifiers, AI usage, infrastructure, domains, labor, and marketing costs, plus experiment-level exposure and incremental outcome records. Until then, reject discretionary spend, forecasts, monetization expansion, unsupported revenue claims, and new production work; continue only existing reconciliation and containment.
